basisNote: Every figure carries a 'basis' describing where it comes from, so anyone citing this index can see exactly what kind of number they are quoting. basisTypes.modeled: Derived from Voltfield's catalog reference data and distributor/mill network. A Voltfield estimate, not a third-party measurement.
basisTypes.operator: Reported by buyers or distributors through the submission form and reviewed by hand before publishing.
basisTypes.published: Traceable to a named public source, given in sourceName and sourceUrl on the item.
